"The magic of the holidays at sea begins the moment guests pack their bags," said Denise Saviss, Princess Cruises Vice President, Entertainment. "From tree lighting festivals to holiday music filling our decks, our sparkling ships and holiday festivities are rooted in tradition and filled with shared moments that sail home with our guests."
'Tis the Season to Sail: Celebrate the Holidays at Sea
Sailings from Thanksgiving through New Year's are filling fast, with limited space still available. Guests looking to celebrate at sea can enjoy unforgettable holiday sailings including:
7-Day Mexican Riviera – November 21-28, 2026 – Discovery Princess – Roundtrip Los Angeles
12-day Panama Canal with Costa Rica and Caribbean Holiday – December 17-29, 2026 – Caribbean Princess – Roundtrip Ft. Lauderdale
6-day Eastern Caribbean with Celebration Key Holiday – December 20-26, 2026 – Regal Princess – Roundtrip Ft. Lauderdale
16-Day Hawaiian Islands Holiday – December 26, 2026 – January 11, 2027 – Ruby Princess – Roundtrip San Francisco
For travelers wishing to get a head start on booking their holiday vacations for next year, 2027 holiday cruises are also on sale now.
Holiday Magic Across the Fleet

Across the Princess fleet, ships will come alive with the magic of the holidays, with winter wonderlands accented by thoughtful holiday décor from sparkling trees and garlands to twinkling lights and festive floral arrangements. Holiday programming varies by ship, with Sphere Class and Royal Class ships featuring a Tree Lighting Celebration with a full cast performance, while other ships across the fleet host a more intimate Festive Tree Lighting featuring vocalists.

Whether it's celebrating Christmas in the Caribbean, toasting the New Year under the stars, or simply enjoying time together away from the hustle and bustle, Princess Cruises offers a truly magical way to celebrate the season with loved ones.

About Princess Cruises:

Princess Cruises is The Love Boat, the world's most iconic cruise brand that delivers dream vacations to millions of guests every year in the most sought-after destinations on the largest ships that offer elite service personalisation and simplicity customary of small, yacht-class ships. Well-appointed staterooms, world class dining, grand performances, award-winning casinos and entertainment, luxurious spas, imaginative experiences and boundless activities blend with exclusive Princess MedallionClass service to create meaningful connections and unforgettable moments in the most incredible settings in the world - the Caribbean, Alaska, Panama Canal, Mexican Riviera, Europe, South America, Australia/New Zealand, the South Pacific, Hawaii, Asia, Canada/New England, Antarctica, and World Cruises. Star Princess, the brand's newest and most innovative ship, launched October 2025, and sister ship to Sun Princess, named Condé Nast Traveler Mega Ship of the Year for a second consecutive year.
